name: B.L.O.O.M.
source:
A short game about a girl named Ruby who works as a mechanic at a local factory. She is going on vacation this month, but before that she needs to assemble a robot to get a promotion!

[Edited from [url=https://pttpss.itch.io/bloom]itch.io[/url]]
